python2.purpose: Python 2 interpreter and standard library; no pip or automatic downloads.

ssh.purpose: PuTTY plink, pscp and psftp. Use explicit verified host keys and portable command-line options; no saved registry sessions.

curl.purpose: HTTP/HTTPS CLI with its own CA bundle. Pass --cacert tools/curl/cacert.pem using the absolute package path.

git.purpose: Portable Git with its complete helper, script and TLS dependencies.

python3.purpose: Python 3 interpreter and standard library, built for this target.

sqlite.purpose: sqlite3 and sqldiff command-line tools; not the yaca data store.

busybox.purpose: Text and shell utilities; invoke the executable followed by an applet name.

compiler.purpose: Relocatable C/C++ development tools including compiler, linker, headers, libraries and Make.

notes: Core retains its XP baseline. The compiler requires SSE2.
Exclude CMake, Ninja and ccache from the XP compiler subset. C11 threads are unavailable on XP.
Python 3.4.10 requires a source build; never relabel an older installer.
Python 3.8.20 requires a source build. Qualify CRT and KB2533623 requirements on an unpatched target.
Test compiler and Git Unicode paths on Windows 7; newer-host results are insufficient.
All programs must run against glibc 2.17.
Compiler payload includes a relocatable sysroot; do not depend on the build host toolchain.
